posts.title: Sideloading anti-hate protection into Vivaldi for Android
posts.description: Back in May, I blogged about the Kill Yr Substack web browser extension. If you install it in your web browser, when you visit a Substack site it will redirect you to an archived version. That way neither Substack nor the author gets the benefit of the clicks.
